---
title: "Indice de Problemas"
---

Explora todos los problemas detectados por metadatos. Puedes buscar por nombre, competencia o ID, y filtrar por tag.

<div class="cp-controls">
  <input id="problem-search" type="search" placeholder="Buscar por titulo, ID o competencia..." />
  <select id="problem-tag">
    <option value="">Todos los tags</option>
  </select>
  <span id="problem-count" class="cp-count"></span>
</div>

<div id="problem-empty" class="cp-empty" style="display:none;">No hay resultados para los filtros actuales.</div>

<div class="table-responsive">
  <table class="table table-striped table-hover cp-table">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th>Problema</th>
        <th>Competencia</th>
        <th>Tags</th>
        <th>Lenguajes</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody id="problem-body"></tbody>
  </table>
</div>

<script>
(async function () {
  const response = await fetch("problems/catalog.json");
  const data = await response.json();

  const searchEl = document.getElementById("problem-search");
  const tagEl = document.getElementById("problem-tag");
  const bodyEl = document.getElementById("problem-body");
  const countEl = document.getElementById("problem-count");
  const emptyEl = document.getElementById("problem-empty");

  const queryCompetition = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("competition") || "";
  if (queryCompetition) {
    searchEl.value = queryCompetition;
  }

  const tags = [...new Set(data.flatMap(item => item.tags || []))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  for (const tag of tags) {
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = tag;
    option.textContent = tag;
    tagEl.appendChild(option);
  }

  function render() {
    const term = searchEl.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const selectedTag = tagEl.value;

    const filtered = data.filter(item => {
      const haystack = [
        item.problem_id,
        item.title,
        item.competition,
        ...(item.languages || []),
      ].join(" ").toLowerCase();

      const matchText = !term || haystack.includes(term);
      const matchTag = !selectedTag || (item.tags || []).includes(selectedTag);
      return matchText && matchTag;
    });

    bodyEl.innerHTML = "";
    for (const item of filtered) {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td><a href="${item.url}"><strong>${item.problem_id}</strong> - ${item.title}</a></td>
        <td>${item.competition}</td>
        <td>${(item.tags || []).map(tag => `<span class="cp-tag">${tag}</span>`).join(" ")}</td>
        <td>${(item.languages || []).join(", ")}</td>
      `;
      bodyEl.appendChild(tr);
    }

    countEl.textContent = `${filtered.length} resultado(s)`;
    emptyEl.style.display = filtered.length === 0 ? "block" : "none";
  }

  searchEl.addEventListener("input", render);
  tagEl.addEventListener("change", render);
  render();
})();
</script>
